d.title: Donten ni Warau Gaiden: Ouka, Tenbou no Kakehashi
d.en: Donten: Laughing Under the Clouds - Gaiden: Chapter 3 - Conspiracy of the Military
d.jp: 曇天に笑う＜外伝＞ ～桜華、天望の架橋～
d.synopsis: The three brothers discover that the human experiment banned after destroying the "Orochi", is still going on to secretly revive the evil snake. They also find out that some ex-members of the Yamainu (the Japanese military unit formed to kill the snake) are behind this conspiracy. The brothers fight together again in a battle against the military.

rel.name: Donten ni Warau Gaiden: Shukumei, Soutou no Fuuma
